Bank of Uganda -
Consolidated Corporate
Governance Guidelines.
column3:
• The Board should have at least four (4) Independent
Non-Executive Directors.
• Separation of Compliance Department as an
Independent Unit reporting to Board Risk Committee.
• The Board should have a succession policy
in place.

column2:
Bank of Uganda -
Customer Due Diligence
(CDD) Guidelines.
column3:
Guidelines introduced minimum customer due diligence
requirements regarding the ownership, the Bank should
identify and verify the natural person (s) who owns at
least five percent (5%) or more shareholding of the legal
person or legal arrangement.

Suspicious Transaction
Reporting (STR)
Guidelines
column3: Enhance suspicious transaction reporting by Banks.

Review of Prudential
Returns for Supervised
Financial Institutions.
column3:
To align data collection with risk-based supervision,
monetary policy and to comply with the East African
Community (EAC) monetary affairs committee
harmonisation criteria as well as global standards in
banking supervision.
